title: Harry B NDE 2873
content: I was sixteen at the time. I went to a party for New Year's Eve. My friends had rented a motel room. I drank a lot of beer, vodka and gin. I passed out in a corner of the room. Someone called the police and they came to break up the party. Everyone there ran away and the only person the police found was me, unconscious in the corner. They could not wake me, so they called an ambulance. They found my ID and called my parents who met me at the hospital. I was in the hospital for two days and nights detoxing. The doctors told me that I was very lucky to survive. During the time I was unconscious, I found myself without a body in the middle of black, misty darkness. The darkness was infinite like space. The blackness was of a color that I had never seen. It had a density, but also clarity. I could see in all directions and move at any speed in any direction. I was hovering in the middle of space without a body. Even though I didn't have a body, I could see as if I had eyes. I didn't need to breathe. I felt perfect peace, love and happiness. In the distance, I saw a big light - the size of a door. I didn't go to the light because I didn't feel the need to go to it. I didn't feel the presence of other beings. I awoke in the hospital and felt the weight of my body, as if I was held down. I felt awful. I left a place of no pain and entered a body of pain. Before the experience, I didn't know if there was an afterlife. After the experience, I knew there is an afterlife. Looking back on the experience, I could have stayed there forever. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 12/31/2004 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Accident Alcohol poisoning 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' Passed out due to intoxication, ambulance called, in hospital for two days. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I felt more aware alive and aware in the blackness than in my daily life. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was in space out of my body. It felt more real than life itself. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither No sense of time. Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Perfect vision. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Did not hear anything. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Saw a door of light. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm ...just black, endless space What emotions did you feel during the experience? Pure love, joy and peace - no pain. It felt like home. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Neither Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Conservative/fundamentalist none(but was raised Mormon) Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I believe in a higher power. I have stronger desire to do good. What is your religion now? Liberal 'none, but believe in God' Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I believe in a higher power. I have stronger desire to do good. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I can talk to people easier. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Felt feelings I never felt before. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Started to see spirit beings. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Just being there was significant. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I immediately told my parents about it when I awoke in the hospital. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes They were different from my experience. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real Was very real to me, as real today (two years later) as it was then. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No.

environment.environment_other_detail: Black, misty, infinite darkness like space; blackness had an unfamiliar color with density and clarity; could see in all directions; a distant light 'the size of a door.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Alcohol poisoning/intoxication at a New Year's Eve party; unconscious, ambulance called; hospitalized for detox for two days; doctors said he was lucky to survive.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Raised Mormon; prior religion reported as 'none' (conservative/fundamentalist: none). Current: 'none, but believe in God' (liberal).

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Reported leaving the body into infinite black misty space/void; saw a distant door-sized light but did not go to it; no beings; then awoke back in the hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Described the darkness as an unfamiliar 'color' with both density and clarity; could move any speed/direction; did not feel a need to go toward the distant 'door'-sized light.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I found myself without a body in the middle of black, misty darkness.” “It felt more real than life itself.” “It felt like home.” “I left a place of no pain and entered a body of pain.”
